name: One-Tray Creamy Chicken Fajita Pasta Bake

components.name: Chicken Fajita Pasta Bake

ingredients.name: Garlic minced (fresh alternative to lazy garlic)

steps: Preheat oven to 190 C. Cut raw chicken, onions and bell peppers into evenly sized pieces.
In a deep ovenproof baking dish mix dry pasta, diced chicken, vegetables, cream cheese, canned tomato, garlic, fajita spice, salt, pepper and measured water until evenly coated.
Spread mixture level, scatter mozzarella across the top and seal the dish tightly with foil.
Bake covered around 45 minutes, then uncover and bake a further five minutes or until pasta is tender, sauce thick and chicken reaches 74 C.
Rest covered 5-10 minutes so pasta absorbs the last moisture. Stir to distribute the creamy sauce and portion into four large servings.
Cool quickly in shallow containers. Reheat gently with a splash of water if the pasta has tightened in storage.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.

Source is a public structured version of a recipe reviewed by Hadrian (his review stated ~551 kcal, 57 g protein, 55 g carbs, 13 g fat). UNHANGRY used 130 g onion and 300 g peppers as fixed converted raw quantities; recalculate before publication.
Planning: Oven-only until plating; source original developer attribution still needs confirmation.
Freezer: creamy texture may change after freeze-thaw
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
